source_evidence: The save/zero prologue is expressed in current source at src/path.cpp:340-343: `int proto_saved = proto_id; if (unk1 & 0x200) { proto_id = 0; }` corresponds to the original 0x0059A54D-0x0059A555 sequence that stores the [ebp+0x18] proto argument into [ebp-0x40] and writes 0 back to the argument slot.

The saved-proto territory exemption is expressed at src/path.cpp:527-529: inside the `unk1 & 0x200` branch the guard `if (faction_id != territory_next && proto_saved != territory_next)` mirrors the paired original compares at 0x0059ADA7 (faction_id) and 0x0059ADB0 (`cmp DWORD PTR [ebp-0x40],ecx / je 0x0059B321`), and proto_saved has exactly this one use in the whole body (grep: declared line 340, used line 529 only).

Every other consumer operates on the zeroed proto_id as the hypothesis states: get_proto_triad/speed_proto at src/path.cpp:344-345, has_abil at 350, and hex_cost at 508 and 744; the transcription note at src/path.cpp:328-330 documents the same [ebp-0x40] insight, so the finding is expressed, not merely planned.

Current diagnostics from the request's functions array (/diagnostics/check/report/candidate/checks/binary/functions) still measure ?find@Path@@QAEHHHHHHHHH@Z fail on extent (candidate 6144 bytes under /O2 /Gy /GR- /GX /Z7 and 5664 under the /Oy- set vs the 5845 recorded extent); incorporation here establishes only that the structural insight is in source, not binary or behavioral proof, and find's convergence remains open measurement work.
